:gelezen uit cache, :geschreven naar cac: :gelezen read from cache, :geschreven written to cache
AI-aanroepen gaan gewoon door; het budge: AI calls continue as normal; the budget does not block anything. Adjust the budget under Settings, AI, or check the AI log to see which features are driving the costs.
AI analyseert pages, artikelen en produc: AI analyzes pages, articles and products of this site and builds a complete tone-of-voice Brief following the 9-part briefing. An existing generated Brief is overwritten; a manual override is kept.
AI genereert voor elk geselecteerd model: AI generates a meta title and meta description in every language for each selected model. The actual generation runs in the background, per record.
Als deze niet beschikbaar is, wordt auto: If this is not available, another connected provider is used automatically.
Automatisch alt-teksten genereren voor n: Automatically generate alt texts for new uploads
Bij 80% en bij 100% van dit bedrag gaat: At 80% and at 100% of this amount an email goes out once a month to the administrators (the invoice notification addresses, otherwise all superadmins). Calls continue as normal.
Bijv. nadruk op lokale SEO of een specif: E.g. emphasis on local SEO or a specific keyword.
Brief wordt op de achtergrond gegenereer: Brief is being generated in the background
Daily-scheduler ververst de Brief wannee: The daily scheduler refreshes the Brief when it is older than this number of days.
De AI-kosten van :maand staan op :bedrag: The AI costs for :maand are at :bedrag (about :eur), which is :procent% of the monthly budget of :budget.
De bedragen zijn schattingen op basis va: The amounts are estimates based on the price table in the CMS, not the provider's invoice.
De Brief is de enige merk-context die bi: The Brief is the only brand context passed along with every AI call. AI generates it based on pages, articles and products of this site. It refreshes automatically every 30 days via the scheduler unless you have filled in a manual override.
De jobs worden op de achtergrond afgevuu: The jobs are fired in the background, per record. Keep an eye on the queue monitor.
De providers factureren in dollars; met: The providers bill in dollars; with this rate the log also shows the amount in euros.
Dit is een waarschuwing vooraf. Bij 100%: This is an early warning. At 100% one more email follows; after that it stays quiet until next month.
Elke aanroep van Claude, OpenAI, Fal.ai: Every call to Claude, OpenAI, Fal.ai and DeepL, with tokens, costs, prompt and response. Default: 365 days.

Every call to Claude, OpenAI, Fal.ai and DeepL ends up in the AI log (System, AI log) with tokens, duration and estimated costs. The costs come from the price table in config/dashed-ai.php and are an estimate, not the provider's invoice.
Gebruikt de vision-capability van de act: Uses the vision capability of the active AI provider. Only works for Dutch.
Geen AI provider met vision capability b: No AI provider with vision capability available
Geen prijs bekend voor dit model; voeg h: No price known for this model; add it to the price table in config/dashed-ai.php.
Genereer alt teksten voor alle afbeeldin: Generate alt texts for all images
Je vindt je API sleutel op fal.ai → API: You can find your API key at fal.ai → API Keys.
Kies de standaard AI provider. De tone-o: Choose the default AI provider. The tone-of-voice Brief below is the only brand context sent with every AI call.
Laat leeg om de gegenereerde Brief te ge: Leave empty to use the generated Brief. Fill in to set the tone manually or to refine the generated version.
Nog geen Brief gegenereerd. Klik bovenaa: No Brief generated yet. Click "Refresh tone-of-voice Brief" at the top to generate one.
Uit: alleen cijfers en context (provider: Off: only numbers and context (provider, model, feature, user, tokens, costs). On: also the full text that went to the AI and came back.
Ververs deze pagina over een minuut om h: Refresh this page in a minute to see the result.
Verwijdert de gegenereerde Brief, de eve: Deletes the generated Brief, any override and the source history. AI calls then run without brand context until you generate again.
Wanneer dit veld is ingevuld, wordt het: When this field is filled in, it is used instead of the generated Brief. The scheduler does not refresh sites with an active override.
Zodra hier een Fal.ai API sleutel staat,: As soon as a Fal.ai API key is set here, a "Generate with AI" button appears on every image field in the CMS. With a reference image nano-banana/edit is used, without a reference flux/dev.
